title: next build --no-mangling keeps mangling

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/inside/no-mangling-option

### To Reproduce

1. `npm install`
2. `npm run build -- --profile --no-mangling`
3. `npm start`
4. Open your browser to `http://localhost:3000`
5. Open the devtools
6. If installed, go to the React Developer Tools profiler tab
7. Click on "Reload and start profiling"
8. After a few seconds, click stop on the red circle

### Expected behavior versus Current

Following the previous section, a flamegraph with no mangled names should appear like shown in the screenshot below:

![image](https://github.com/inside/no-mangling-option/assets/107884/ed372007-9a13-4327-8377-12b05f1efc2f)

Instead a flamegraph with mangled names appears like shown in the screenshot below:

![image](https://github.com/inside/no-mangling-option/assets/107884/0233417f-875e-43f9-b7aa-546adb847ae5)
